metadata.name: Multiscale-SBM
metadata.candidate_definition: A: bottom degree quartile, different blocks; B: top degree quartile, same block
metadata.degree_baseline: static ascending sum of weighted endpoint degrees; candidate-index ties
metadata.source: Exact reconstruction of the locked multiscale benchmark JSON.

metadata.name: Heterogeneous-Multiscale
metadata.generator: 4 BA(100,3) blocks; independent lognormal edge multipliers, sigma=0.35
metadata.candidate_definition: 75 cross-block candidates, split between bottom/top weighted-degree quartiles; 75 intrablock top-quartile nonedges

protocol.timings: five fresh complete runs; no shared or cached Phase-1 between repetitions
protocol.scan: locked heterogeneous graph; all 7 s x 4 alpha combinations, q=12
protocol.structure: unchanged base graph; all k selected edges, including any intrablock edges
protocol.heat: exact full dense eigenspectra; Delta H(tau)=tr(exp(-tau L0))-tr(exp(-tau LS))
protocol.allocation: block0 is the lowest-weight module; blocks2,3 are highest-weight cores; categories fixed before running
protocol.no_search: locked graphs reused; no graph, seed or parameter search to produce a favorable trend
protocol.modal_fraction: arithmetic mean over initial crossing candidates of sum_{i=1}^4 lambda_i^(s-1)(b^T v_i)^2 / sum_i lambda_i^(s-1)(b^T v_i)^2
protocol.regularization: A=I+alpha L: logdet derivative weights 1/(1+alpha lambda_L) are bounded at lambda_L=0
protocol.evidence: a spectral objective does not guarantee dominance at any prescribed heat horizon
